description:
Advances: ancora.parsing

ancora.parsing.tag_discovery (stable must) requires discovering moduletag spec values in every test file. A moduletag in a file whose only tests are ExUnitProperties property blocks never binds; TagScanner attaches tags to test statements only. Details in first comment.

comments.text:
Found by the L13 cold verifier (2026-09-01): `test/ancora/output_property_test.exs:8` carries `@moduletag spec: "ancora.tasks.no_result_leak"`, but the file's only test is an ExUnitProperties `property` block. `Ancora.TagScanner` (lib/ancora/tag_scanner.ex) attaches tags to `test` statements only — no `property` clause — so the moduletag never binds and `tags/requirement_untagged` reports the id untagged (info severity, hidden inside result=pass).

ancora.parsing.tag_discovery (stable must) says the scanner shall discover `@tag spec:`, `@moduletag spec:`, and `@describetag spec:` values in every `**/*_test.exs` under test_paths. A property-only file is such a file; this is a requirement violation, not an enhancement.

Deliverable: scanner support for `property` statements (including describe-nested and for-comprehension bodies, matching the existing `test` handling), with tests covering (a) `@moduletag spec:` on a property-only file, (b) inline `@tag spec:` directly on a property, (c) a describe-nested property. Would-fail: each new test red against the current scanner.

Blocks the rc.1 publish (ancora-yzu.16): shipping with a violated stable must in ancora.parsing is not acceptable. Does NOT block L13 (ancora-yzu.15) — its bounce has a test-side remedy available; if this fix lands first, the existing moduletag simply starts counting.
